name: web-collapsing-pill-navigation-that-shrinks-to-a-circle-on-scroll
title: Grey page with a small white pill nav (logo, Home, About, Services, Contact) above 'Navigation with Framer Motion' and a scroll instruction
whatItIs: A pale grey page with a floating white pill at the top centre holding an arrow logo and four grey links, a bold black heading 'Navigation with Framer Motion' and a grey line explaining that the nav collapses on scroll and expands on click.
whatItMeans: Light and playful; a nav that shrinks to a circle stays out of the way.
techniques: Float a pill nav at the top.
Collapse it into a circle on scroll.

vocabulary.definition: A navigation that shrinks while scrolling.
A rounded bar hovering above the page.
The collapsed version showing just an icon.
